{'text': '由Lena Dunham主演、於2012年至2017年間播出的喜劇劇集，將於2027年某個時間以限定的五集形式回歸，該有線電視頻道於週二宣布。', 'paragraph_context': 'The Lena Dunham comedy show, which ran from 2012 to 2017, will be returning for a limited five-episode run sometime in 2027, the cable channel announced on Tuesday.'}

{'text': '原班底成員Allison Williams、Jemima Kirke、Zosia Mamet及Andrew Rannalls將會加入這次迷你復活季。', 'paragraph_context': 'Dunham will be joined on the mini-revival by original cast members Allison Williams, Jemima Kirke, Zosia Mamet and Andrew Rannalls.'}

{'text': '同樣憑藉該劇嶄露頭角的Adam Driver，在復活消息中則未被提及，《荷里活報道》指出。', 'paragraph_context': 'Adam Driver, who also got his break on the series, was not mentioned in the revival announcement, the Hollywood Reporter noted.'}

{'text': '復活季的首播日期尚未公布，但Dunham及其他回歸演員已在Instagram上暢談這次重聚。', 'paragraph_context': 'No premiere date for the revival has been announced, but Dunham and the other returning cast members dished on the reunion on Instagram.'}

{'text': 'Dunham在隨消息發表的聲明中，解釋了回歸的原因。', 'paragraph_context': 'Dunham explained the reason for returning in a statement accompanying the announcement.'}

{'text': 'Dunham表示：「我們一直說，只有當有個非講不可的故事時，我們才會回歸《Girls》。」她說：「我掛念這些角色，但很長一段時間裡，我無法想像她們在當下的樣子。然後，就在我四十歲生日前後，她們開始在淋浴時跟我說話。而且，你們或許還記得，一旦這五個人開始說話，要她們停下來可不容易。」', 'paragraph_context': '“We always said we would only return to ‘Girls’ if there was a specific story we were burning to tell,” Dunham said. “I’ve missed these characters, but for a long time I couldn’t quite picture them in the present day. Then, right around my fortieth birthday, they started talking to me in the shower. And, as you may remember, once this fivesome starts talking, it’s pretty hard to get them to stop.”'}

{'text': '「能夠帶著後知之覺，以及全新的感恩與理解，重新回到一部改變你人生的作品，是十分難得的機會。我愛這些女孩（和男孩）、我們在HBO的朋友，以及所有繼續發現這部劇、讓我們重新體會為何要做這件事的人——也就是相聚的喜悅……還有穿上黃色網紗的機會。」', 'paragraph_context': '“It’s rare that you get the chance to return to something that changed your life with the gift of hindsight and a whole new level of gratitude and understanding. I love these girls (and boy), our friends at HBO and all the people who have continued to discover the show and remind us afresh why we do this, which is the joy of being together… and the chance to wear yellow mesh.”'}

{'text': '這算不上什麼意外。', 'paragraph_context': 'This isn’t exactly a surprise.'}

{'text': 'Dunham早前在個人Substack專頁的文章中，已暗示了這些角色過去十年的狀況。', 'paragraph_context': 'In an essay on her Substack page, Dunham hinted at how the characters have fared over the last decade.'}

{'text': '她寫道：「嚴格來說，我們已經不再是女孩了。我們再也不能被稱為早熟、嬌媚或柔弱。」她說：「我們比那些著名的文學老處女——Bridget Jones、Miss Havisham和Blanche DuBois——都還要年長。」', 'paragraph_context': '“We are not, strictly speaking, girls anymore. We couldn’t be called precocious, coquettish or fawn-like,” she said. “We are older than notorious literary spinsters Bridget Jones, Miss Havisham and Blanche DuBois.”'}
